name: Summer Teen Volunteering at Henry Ford Providence Novi
what_you_do: Teens give 4 hours a week at the hospital. You work the same day, time and department each week.
who_can_apply: High school students and 2027 high school graduates who are ages 16 to 17. You must be 16 by June 16, 2027. You must be free for 9 or more weeks in June, July and August 2027.
deadline_text: Apply from March 1 to March 15, 2027 for summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Send the information form from March 1 to March 15, 2027. Go to an information session. Pass a background check. Do a health screen. Finish a training packet. Letters of recommendation are optional.
notes: Only a limited number of teens are accepted. Others go on a wait list. Selected candidates need a TB test and TDap and MMR shots. The hospital covers the cost.
